_doc: Mythical Gates. Built from compact specs; see CLAUDE.md > Gates.

gates.name: the Bronze Labyrinth
gates.description: A rift in a sheep field outside the village opens onto corridors of green bronze that rearrange themselves when no one is looking.
gates.entry_text: The walls are warm, like the flank of a sleeping animal. Somewhere ahead, hooves strike metal in a slow, patient rhythm.

rooms.text: Two cultists in bull masks chant at a junction. They stop chanting when they see you.
The floor here is a grid of bronze plates. Some of them click.

check.success: You step only on the quiet plates and find a loose panel of bronze at the far side.
check.fail: A plate drops and a bronze spike punches up through your boot.

rooms.text: A bronze hound noses out of the wall itself, and a cultist follows it on a chain.

bronze_labyrinth_minotaur.title: Asterion the Penned
bronze_labyrinth_minotaur.intro: At the center, a bull-headed giant paces a ring worn deep into the bronze. He was a man once; the System's label says PRISONER, and under it, WARDEN.
bronze_labyrinth_minotaur.victory: Asterion kneels, and the walls of the labyrinth go still for the first time.

study.text: He always turns left. Every circuit, every charge. Wait on his right.

aftermath.label: Leave him where he fell, inside his ring.
aftermath.text: The ring holds him. The labyrinth has a prisoner again, of a sort.

aftermath.label: Break the ring open so nothing is penned here again.
aftermath.text: The bronze shrieks as it parts. Every corridor in the maze unlocks at once.

bronze_labyrinth_ghost_warden.title: the Penned Ghost
bronze_labyrinth_ghost_warden.intro: Asterion's ghost paces the same ring, horns trailing mist. He still cannot leave, and he has stopped wanting to.
bronze_labyrinth_ghost_warden.victory: The ghost breaks apart like breath on a cold morning.
bronze_labyrinth_ghost_warden.arrival_omen: Hoofprints of frost circle the ring at the labyrinth's heart, though nothing walks there.
bronze_labyrinth_ghost_warden.arrival_rumour: Shepherds near the Bronze Labyrinth say a ghost bull still walks its ring at night.

study.text: The ghost is bound to the ring. Fight it from outside the line.

bronze_labyrinth_maze_cult.title: High Priestess {name} of the Horn
bronze_labyrinth_maze_cult.intro: With the ring broken, the cultists have claimed the center. High Priestess {name} wears Asterion's horns as a crown.
bronze_labyrinth_maze_cult.victory: The horn crown rolls across the bronze, and the cultists flee into corridors that no longer move.
bronze_labyrinth_maze_cult.arrival_omen: Bull-mask cultists have painted the broken ring with fresh red horns.
bronze_labyrinth_maze_cult.arrival_rumour: A horned cult has taken the heart of the Bronze Labyrinth and crowned a priestess there.

study.text: Her chant keeps the walls moving. Interrupt her and the cultists lose their way.

bronze_labyrinth_bronze_bull.title: the Bronze Bull
bronze_labyrinth_bronze_bull.intro: The labyrinth has built itself a new guardian: a bull of solid bronze, steam venting from its nostrils, eyes like furnace doors.
bronze_labyrinth_bronze_bull.victory: The Bronze Bull topples, ringing like a struck bell, and its furnace eyes go dark.
bronze_labyrinth_bronze_bull.arrival_omen: The walls have gone hot. Something is being cast in the heart of the maze.
bronze_labyrinth_bronze_bull.arrival_rumour: The Bronze Labyrinth has made itself a guardian of solid metal. Hunters hear it bellow through the walls.

study.text: Its joints are new and stiff. Make it turn, again and again.

gates.name: the Hollow Under the Hill
gates.description: A ring of white mushrooms by the roadside camp has become a door. People who step in come out a day later, sure only an hour has passed.
gates.entry_text: The light is the gold of late afternoon, always. Music plays from no direction, and the trees lean in to listen to you.

rooms.text: A swarm of thorn pixies giggles in a hawthorn, then dives at your eyes.
A banquet table is laid for one. The food smells wonderful.

check.success: You eat nothing and take only the dewglass goblet. Wise.
check.fail: You take one bite. You lose an hour and a little of yourself.

rooms.text: A knight made of briars bows, formally, and draws a sword of thorns.

fae_hollow_queen.title: Queen {name} of the Hollow
fae_hollow_queen.intro: Queen {name} sits on a throne of living thorn and smiles with too many teeth. 'A guest! Guests must play.'
fae_hollow_queen.victory: The Queen dissolves into a spray of petals, laughing as if she won.

study.text: Fae cannot lie. Ask her a question she must answer, and she will hesitate.

fae_hollow_jester.title: the Thornwood Jester
fae_hollow_jester.intro: Without a queen, the court has crowned its fool. The Jester juggles knives made from the queen's thorns.
fae_hollow_jester.victory: The Jester takes a last bow and falls over, still grinning.
fae_hollow_jester.arrival_omen: Bells jingle somewhere in the Thornwood. The empty throne wears a crooked paper crown.
fae_hollow_jester.arrival_rumour: The fae court under the hill has crowned its fool. Travellers lose their purses and their sense of direction.

study.text: Every trick has a rhythm. Strike on the catch, not the throw.

fae_hollow_wild_hunt.title: the Huntsman of the Wild Hunt
fae_hollow_wild_hunt.intro: Your arcane arts tore the glamour from the hollow. What is underneath is older: an antlered huntsman and his briar hounds.
fae_hollow_wild_hunt.victory: The Huntsman's horn cracks, and the Hunt's baying fades into the hills.
fae_hollow_wild_hunt.arrival_omen: A horn sounds far off in the Thornwood. The mushrooms have all turned to face the gate.
fae_hollow_wild_hunt.arrival_rumour: The Wild Hunt rides out of the hollow under the hill. Lock your doors on the nights the horn sounds.

study.text: The Hunt rides only while the horn sounds. Break the horn's note.

fae_hollow_changeling.title: the Changeling Prince
fae_hollow_changeling.intro: A beautiful boy sits on the thorn throne. He looks exactly like someone you lost, and he knows it.
fae_hollow_changeling.victory: The Changeling's borrowed face slides off like water, and under it there is only bark.
fae_hollow_changeling.arrival_omen: A cradle has appeared beside the empty throne, rocking gently by itself.
fae_hollow_changeling.arrival_rumour: A changeling prince rules the hollow under the hill now. He wears whatever face you miss the most.

study.text: It wears a face you love. Close your eyes and listen for the rustle of leaves.

gates.name: the Hydra Fen
gates.description: South of the village a rift has drowned an orchard. The water is warm, and something under it breathes in nine places at once.
gates.entry_text: The fen steams. Every ripple seems to start at the center and come straight for you.

rooms.text: Lizardmen rise from the reeds, spears dripping with something green.
The safe path is a line of half-sunk stones, slick with algae.

check.success: You cross without a splash and find a scale caught in the reeds.
check.fail: You slip into the water and something with teeth finds your leg.

rooms.text: Leeches the size of dogs drift towards the warmth of you.

hydra_fen_hydra.title: the Fen Hydra
hydra_fen_hydra.intro: Nine heads rise from the pool, each one turning to watch you with a different expression of hunger.
hydra_fen_hydra.victory: The last head sinks with a long, tired hiss.

study.text: Each head cut off grows back unless the stump is sealed. Fire, or something like it.

hydra_fen_brood.title: the Hydra's Brood
hydra_fen_brood.intro: The hydra's eggs have hatched. A brood of hydra young, three heads each, squabble over the corpse of their mother.
hydra_fen_brood.victory: The brood scatters into the reeds, and the biggest of them stays down.
hydra_fen_brood.arrival_omen: Leathery eggs float at the edge of the pool, and something inside them is scratching.
hydra_fen_brood.arrival_rumour: The Fen Hydra left eggs. The fen south of the village is full of small heads now, and they are growing.

study.text: The young fight each other first. Let them.

hydra_fen_cauterized.title: the Cauterized Hydra
hydra_fen_cauterized.intro: Magic sealed the wounds, and the hydra grew back wrong: fewer heads, but each one breathes a gout of boiling steam.
hydra_fen_cauterized.victory: The Cauterized Hydra goes down in a cloud of its own steam.
hydra_fen_cauterized.arrival_omen: The pool is boiling. Something under it is growing back with scar tissue instead of heads.
hydra_fen_cauterized.arrival_rumour: Someone burned the Fen Hydra's stumps. It came back anyway, and now it breathes steam.

study.text: It must breathe in before it breathes out. Count the breaths.

hydra_fen_fen_witch.title: {name}, Witch of the Fen
hydra_fen_fen_witch.intro: With the hydra line ended, the lizardfolk serve a witch. {name} stirs the pool like a cauldron and croons to the eggs at the bottom.
hydra_fen_fen_witch.victory: {name} sinks into her own pool. Somewhere under it, an egg cracks.
hydra_fen_fen_witch.arrival_omen: Bundles of bones and feathers hang from every reed. Lizardfolk kneel on the bank.
hydra_fen_fen_witch.arrival_rumour: A witch rules the Hydra Fen now, and she is raising something in the pool.

study.text: Her charms hang on the reeds. Cut the reeds and the lizardfolk forget her.

gates.name: the Gorgon's Garden
gates.description: A walled garden of statues, every one of them an adventurer, every one of them wearing the same last expression.
gates.entry_text: The roses are stone. The birds in the trees are stone. You catch a flicker of movement in a fountain and look away just in time.

rooms.text: Asps with stone-grey scales slither out of the hedges.
A hall of mirrors, angled so that every one shows the garden's center.

check.success: You walk it with your eyes closed, counting steps, and find a tear of stone on the floor.
check.fail: You glimpse a reflection, and your left arm goes stiff and grey for a terrible moment.

rooms.text: A statue of a weeping knight steps off its plinth.

gorgon_garden_gorgon.title: Euryale the Gorgon
gorgon_garden_gorgon.intro: She sits by a fountain with her back to you, her snakes asleep. 'Don't look,' she says. 'Nobody ever listens.'
gorgon_garden_gorgon.victory: Euryale's snakes go limp, and she sighs, almost relieved.

study.text: Watch her in the water of the fountain, never in the flesh.

aftermath.label: Take her head. It might be useful.
aftermath.text: Wrapped in cloth, it is heavy, and it whispers.

aftermath.label: Bury her among the statues she made.
aftermath.text: You dig until your hands bleed. The statues seem to bow their heads.

gorgon_garden_headless.title: the Headless Sister
gorgon_garden_headless.intro: Her sister has come for her. Stheno moves on her own snakes, blind with grief and furious with it.
gorgon_garden_headless.victory: Stheno falls beside the empty plinth where her sister sat.
gorgon_garden_headless.arrival_omen: A second set of snake tracks circles the fountain, around and around, searching.
gorgon_garden_headless.arrival_rumour: Someone took the gorgon's head. Now her sister walks the garden, and she is blind with rage.

study.text: She hunts by sound. Move only when she screams.

gorgon_garden_mourners.title: the Mourners' Vigil
gorgon_garden_mourners.intro: With their killer buried among them, the stone mourners have woken to grieve. They do not want visitors.
gorgon_garden_mourners.victory: The First Mourner cracks down the middle, and the others settle back onto their plinths.
gorgon_garden_mourners.arrival_omen: The statues have turned on their plinths to face the new grave.
gorgon_garden_mourners.arrival_rumour: The statues in the Gorgon's Garden are moving. They gather at a grave at night.

study.text: They are bound to their plinths. Lure them off and they crumble.

gorgon_garden_basilisk.title: the Garden Basilisk
gorgon_garden_basilisk.intro: A serpent king, crowned with a crest of bone, has hatched from a cockerel's egg in the rose bed. Its gaze does the gorgon's work, but faster.
gorgon_garden_basilisk.victory: The Basilisk catches its reflection in your blade and goes still as the garden.
gorgon_garden_basilisk.arrival_omen: Every rose in the garden is turning to stone, one by one, from the center outward.
gorgon_garden_basilisk.arrival_rumour: A basilisk has hatched in the Gorgon's Garden. Not even the hunters who just look are coming back.

study.text: It can't stand its own reflection. A polished shield would do.

gates.name: the Temple of the Drowned Bell
gates.description: A rift in the river near Verath opens on a sea temple, its pillars hung with weed. A bell tolls under the water at every high tide.
gates.entry_text: The air is wet enough to drink. Fish swim past at head height, in water that isn't there.

rooms.text: Fish-eyed temple guards rise from a flooded pool, tridents in hand.
An offering bowl, heaped with black pearls, rests under the gaze of a coral idol.

check.success: You take only a pearl, and the idol's eyes stay closed.
check.fail: You take a pearl and the idol's eyes open. The water rises to your chest before it recedes.

rooms.text: Eels with glowing lures drift through the air of the nave.

drowned_bell_kraken.title: the Bell-Ringer Kraken
drowned_bell_kraken.intro: Tentacles wrap the great bronze bell, and with each slow swing of it the Kraken calls the tide.
drowned_bell_kraken.victory: The Kraken lets go of the bell, and it rings once more, by itself, and falls silent.

study.text: Between tolls, it must let go of the bell. That is the moment.

drowned_bell_high_priest.title: Tide-Priest {name}
drowned_bell_high_priest.intro: The Kraken's worshippers have chosen a new voice. Tide-Priest {name} rings the bell by hand now, and every toll pulls at your blood.
drowned_bell_high_priest.victory: The Tide-Priest falls against the bell. It booms, and the deep ones scatter.
drowned_bell_high_priest.arrival_omen: Pilgrims' candles float in the flooded nave, and a hand-rope has been tied to the bell.
drowned_bell_high_priest.arrival_rumour: The deep ones of the Drowned Bell have a new priest. The river tides near Verath are wrong now.

study.text: Every toll is a prayer. Make him miss a beat.

drowned_bell_bell_spirit.title: the Bell's Voice
drowned_bell_bell_spirit.intro: Your arcane arts woke the bell itself. It rings without a ringer, and the sound has a shape, and the shape has teeth.
drowned_bell_bell_spirit.victory: The bell cracks from lip to crown, and the Voice dies in the middle of a note.
drowned_bell_bell_spirit.arrival_omen: The bell is humming, very low, with nobody near it.
drowned_bell_bell_spirit.arrival_rumour: The Drowned Bell rings by itself now. Fishermen on the river hear it in their bones.

study.text: Sound needs air. The Voice is weakest between notes.

drowned_bell_leviathan_spawn.title: the Leviathan Spawn
drowned_bell_leviathan_spawn.intro: Something came up from the deepest part of the rift to see what killed the bell's keepers. It is young, for its kind. It fills the chamber.
drowned_bell_leviathan_spawn.victory: The Leviathan Spawn slides back down into the dark water and does not rise.
drowned_bell_leviathan_spawn.arrival_omen: The water in the Bell Chamber has dropped a full fathom, as if something enormous drank it.
drowned_bell_leviathan_spawn.arrival_rumour: Something huge has come up from the deep under the Drowned Bell. The river is running backwards some nights.

study.text: It has never fought on land. Draw it up the temple stairs.

gates.name: the Phoenix Ashery
gates.description: A hill north of Verath burns without fuel. The System registers it as a Gate, and as a nest.
gates.entry_text: The ash is ankle deep and warm, and in it you see footprints of birds the size of horses.

rooms.text: Burning chicks the size of wolves hop out of the ash, hungry.
A slope of loose ash over burning coals.

check.success: You run it lightly and pluck a cinder from the edge of the fire.
check.fail: The ash gives way and your legs sink into the coals.

rooms.text: Figures made of ash rise from old pyres: people who tried to steal an egg.

phoenix_ashery_phoenix.title: Ignis the Phoenix
phoenix_ashery_phoenix.intro: On a pyre at the summit, a bird of white fire spreads wings wider than a house. Ignis does not attack at once. It is curious about you.
phoenix_ashery_phoenix.victory: Ignis folds its wings and collapses into a heap of ash. Something in the ash still glows.

study.text: It burns hottest when it is afraid. Don't corner it.

aftermath.label: Leave the ash undisturbed.
aftermath.text: The glow pulses, slowly, like a heartbeat.

aftermath.label: Scatter the ash to the winds so it can't rise again.
aftermath.text: The wind takes it. The hill goes cold for the first time since the Fracture.

phoenix_ashery_reborn.title: Ignis Reborn
phoenix_ashery_reborn.intro: The phoenix rose again, as phoenixes do. It remembers you. It is no longer curious.
phoenix_ashery_reborn.victory: Ignis falls again, and this time the ash is quieter.
phoenix_ashery_reborn.arrival_omen: The ash heap on the summit is pulsing, brighter every day.
phoenix_ashery_reborn.arrival_rumour: The Phoenix of the Ashery has risen again, and it remembers who killed it.

study.text: Reborn things are new. Its left wing has not finished growing.

phoenix_ashery_cold_lord.title: the Cold Ash Lord
phoenix_ashery_cold_lord.intro: With the fire scattered, the hill froze. Something that hated the phoenix has crept into the cold: a lord of grey ash and frost.
phoenix_ashery_cold_lord.victory: The Cold Ash Lord crumbles. Under it, a single coal still glows.
phoenix_ashery_cold_lord.arrival_omen: Frost has formed on the ash of the summit, and grey figures stand very still in it.
phoenix_ashery_cold_lord.arrival_rumour: The burning hill north of Verath has gone cold, and something grey walks on it.

study.text: It is made of the phoenix's leavings. A spark would undo it.

phoenix_ashery_egg_thieves.title: the Egg-Thief Company
phoenix_ashery_egg_thieves.intro: A mercenary company has dug into the nest to steal what grows there. Captain {name} wears fireproof leathers and a very tired expression.
phoenix_ashery_egg_thieves.victory: The Captain yields, and the company flees down the hill. The egg they were guarding is warm, and cracking.
phoenix_ashery_egg_thieves.arrival_omen: Tents and digging tools have appeared around the pyre. Someone is guarding something.
phoenix_ashery_egg_thieves.arrival_rumour: Mercenaries are digging for a phoenix egg on the Ashery hill. They will pay well for help, and worse for interference.

study.text: They are carrying a very fragile egg. They will not fight near it.

gates.name: the Hoard of Vael-Ashar
gates.description: A mountain rift east of Verath, rated A-class. Its first master was a dragon who has slept on his gold since before the Fracture.
gates.entry_text: Gold coins have spilled down the tunnel like scree. Your torch catches eyes in the dark that are only the gems in old crowns.

rooms.text: Kobolds swarm out of holes in a wall of coin, screaming about thieves.
A side cave piled with treasure. A scale glints among the coins.

check.success: You take the scale and a fistful of nothing else. The gold does not stir.
check.fail: The coins shift and slide. You are buried to the waist before you dig out.

rooms.text: A young drake has been sleeping in the tunnel. It wakes up cross.

wyrm_hoard_dragon.title: Vael-Ashar the Old
wyrm_hoard_dragon.intro: A dragon lies coiled on a sea of gold, each scale the size of a door. One eye opens, a lamp of molten amber. 'Another one,' he says. 'Take a coin, little thief. Take it and die.'
wyrm_hoard_dragon.victory: Vael-Ashar's great head sinks onto his gold, and his last breath is only smoke.

study.text: He is old, and his left wing never healed from some forgotten war. Stay on his left.

wyrm_hoard_kobold_king.title: King {name} of the Hoard
wyrm_hoard_kobold_king.intro: The dragon's kobolds have crowned one of their own. King {name} sits on the dragon's skull and holds a sword far too big for him.
wyrm_hoard_kobold_king.victory: King {name} falls off the skull. The kobolds immediately begin to fight over the crown.
wyrm_hoard_kobold_king.arrival_omen: Tiny footprints all over the gold. Someone has hung a kobold-sized crown on the dragon's skull.
wyrm_hoard_kobold_king.arrival_rumour: The kobolds of Vael-Ashar's hoard have crowned a king. He is very small, and very angry.

study.text: The kobolds follow the crown, not the king. Knock it off his head.

wyrm_hoard_dracolich.title: Vael-Ashar, Unburied
wyrm_hoard_dracolich.intro: Your magic did not let him rest. The dragon has risen as a dracolich, bones lacquered in gold, a cold green fire where his heart was.
wyrm_hoard_dracolich.victory: The green fire gutters out, and Vael-Ashar's bones collapse into his gold for the last time.
wyrm_hoard_dracolich.arrival_omen: The dragon's bones are gone from the hoard. Something has been dragged across the gold, toward the deeper caves.
wyrm_hoard_dracolich.arrival_rumour: Vael-Ashar has risen as a dracolich. The miners east of Verath have abandoned their tunnels.

study.text: The green fire is his phylactery. Strike it and nothing else.

wyrm_hoard_heir.title: {name}, Heir of the Hoard
wyrm_hoard_heir.intro: A young dragon, scales still bright, has come to claim the hoard. {name} is smaller than the old dragon, faster, and much less patient.
wyrm_hoard_heir.victory: {name} limps away into the deep caves, leaving the hoard behind.
wyrm_hoard_heir.arrival_omen: Fresh claw marks on the hoard hall walls, and a scorched patch where something young has been practising its fire.
wyrm_hoard_heir.arrival_rumour: A young dragon has claimed Vael-Ashar's hoard. Its fire is still learning.

study.text: Young dragons love to show off their fire. Make it breathe, then close in.
